correctness.rationale: The source sextic is an exact coordinate-squaring pullback of a nodal cubic with node at [1:1:1]. Expanding the cubic at this point gives a nondegenerate tangent quadratic precisely when L != 0. A tangent is a line component precisely when R=0, so LR != 0 implies a geometrically integral nodal cubic. The two pullback squareclasses have distinct odd-valuation witnesses on axes, proving a connected degree-four Kummer cover. The symmetric cubic discriminant Δ controls axis intersection multiplicities: simple gives smooth lifts, double gives two nodes per axis, triple two cusps per axis. The triple-root and LR conditions force (a,b)=(3,3). The four torus nodes plus 6 axis nodes or 6 cusps yield normalization genera 6 or 0 by the plane sextic arithmetic genus 10. Symbolic and independent exact F25 checkers were actually run and passed. Finite enumeration is corroboration only.

value.rationale: A complete exact degeneration classification of a natural published two-parameter genus-six family has intrinsic value: the discriminant boundary unexpectedly consists of rational degree-six plane curves with the maximal ten ordinary nodes, apart from a single member with six ordinary cusps and four nodes. Distinguishing genus six from genus zero and proving singularity type is a meaningful geometric constraint for choosing arithmetic curve constructions, not merely checking smoothness of a special equation.
